========== ========== ========== ==========
  FlashAir RTC Synchronize Tool  v0.03
========== ========== ========== ==========

【 Software Name 】FlashAir RTC Synchronize Tool
【 Author 】Yuukun
【 Operating System 】MSX-DOS2
【 Version 】0.03
【 Last Update 】2017/03/12
【 File Name 】FA_CLOCK.COM

【 Website 】https://miyako.asablo.jp/blog

---------- ----------
◇ Overview ◇
Retrieve time from RTC via FlashAir's iSDIO interface and set the MSX time.
Does not interact with FlashAir through FAT (file system). Should work if there is
an SD card interface compatible with MegaSD.

◇ Operating Conditions ◇
Works with MSX having MegaSD-compatible SD card interface (like 1chipMSX) & FlashAir W-03.
FA_CLOCK.COM itself handles SD card initialization, so SDHC support is not a mandatory requirement.

◇ Usage ◇
Set the current time on FlashAir's RTC using Lua script at startup.
Then, running this program from MSX-DOS2 will retrieve the time from FlashAir's RTC
and set the MSX time.

See the sample Lua script below:
https://miyako.asablo.jp/blog/2017/03/05/8393672


The following options are available:

/R[0-F]   Specify the number of attempts to read FlashAir's RTC.
          If /R0, it will retry indefinitely (255 times).
          Pressing any key during retry will interrupt.
          Default is A (10 times).

/Sxx      Specifies the slot where the SD card is connected.
          The default is 8D (3-2) for 1chipMSX.
          Adjust appropriately for use with MegaFlashROM SCC+ SD.

FA_CLOCK.COM itself handles SD card initialization.
Thus, even normal 1chipMSX (without SDHC support) can retrieve time
from RTC by running FA_CLOCK.COM from ESE-RAM, etc.
with FlashAir set to retrieve RTC via Lua script.

◇ Disclaimer ◇
We are not responsible for any damage or loss
caused by the use of this software.
Use at your own risk.

◇ FAQ & Known Bugs ◇
We do not own a MegaFlashROM SCC+ SD, so slot specifications
are untested.
